title: Terrain workshop — brush recovery + grenades
goal: Try Flatten, then switch back to Raise/Lower. Check that edits keep arriving. Press F1 while edits are pending and watch the queue finish, then throw grenades in play mode.
changes: Fixed expanding dirty-chunk queues after unfinished edits. Flatten now has a local footprint and holds the first clicked height throughout a stroke. F1 queues play with live progress and enters automatically when ready. Grenades use the existing 2-second fuse and quick-settling bounce; B throws a small terrain-cutting grenade.
controls:
Raise/Lower: hold LMB. Flatten: press at the target height, hold and drag. RMB + WASD: fly; Space/Ctrl: up/down. Wheel: zoom; Shift-wheel: brush size.
F1: queue play / return to edit (press again while queued to cancel). B in play: grenade. F: walk/fly. F8: mark BEGIN/END around a slow operation. F3: chunks. F2: briefing.
Tunnel controls unchanged: drag centre handles, or click a surface to place the active end. Save explicitly to retain authored terrain and grenade craters.
